subject: Quick change for Saturday?
text:
Hi,

Hope your week is going okay. I need to bounce a quick question your way because the classmate group chat has just shifted again. A few people can no longer make the Saturday morning meeting at the library, apparently due to family plans, and the whole thing has become a bit of a jigsaw puzzle.

We have three people who could meet Sunday afternoon instead, but only until three, and two others who prefer later in the evening. That still leaves the original location unusable, so I started asking whether the community room upstairs might have a free hour after one. If we can hold it, I can confirm everyone by tonight. If not, we may need to move the short prep session online for now and keep the longer brainstorm for next week.

I know you are already sorting the schedule for the larger group, so this is a little late. Could you tell me by early evening if Sunday works at all? I can send a new calendar update right away. Sorry for the last-minute change.
